payload.title: Calibrate suggestions from decisions (Wilson cut per site)
payload.description:
Per site, over suggestions a person decided: the smallest similarity t at which the Wilson 95% lower bound of the accept share among suggestions scored >= t reaches the site's target precision (same statistic as auto_accept.py). Above t: shown first, marked "likely" (text); below: "possible". Too few decisions: no t, recorded like auto_accept. Replaces the knee in S2.6 once it exists. Separate cuts for reference links and concept links.
Tests: synthetic decision sets give the expected t or none.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
